q: The Melnikov function for a periodically forced planar system ẋ = f(x) + εg(x,t) measures the distance between stable and unstable manifolds. When M(t₀) has a simple zero:
opts: The system has a periodic orbit
The manifolds intersect transversally, implying chaotic dynamics by Smale-Birkhoff
exp: A simple zero of the Melnikov function implies transverse homoclinic intersection of stable and unstable manifolds. By Smale-Birkhoff, transverse homoclinic points imply a horseshoe, hence topological chaos (positive entropy, sensitive dependence).
